verdict.rationale: SumUp documents a Cloud API for starting transactions from a POS on any platform that can send HTTPS requests and completing them on a Solo reader. The docs also describe triggering and managing payments on Solo or Go readers via HTTPS, pairing and naming multiple readers, running simultaneous transactions with no distance limit, and testing against Virtual Solo with a sandbox account. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Cloud API terminal flow, documentation of how terminal transaction results and status reach the backend (the evidenced webhooks cover online checkout status only), and a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
